params.agent: The agent address that will execute payments.
params.allowAnyPayee: If false, payees must be added via `setPayeeAllowed`.
params.expiresAt: Unix timestamp after which payments revert (must be future).
params.token: ERC-20 to spend (tUSD8 on QDay Aevum).

params.memo: Free-text reference (invoice id, order hash, …) stored             permanently in the PaymentExecuted event for auditability.

closeExpired(uint256).notice: After expiry, anyone may close the mandate; unspent funds are         returned to the owner. (The owner can also simply `revoke`.)

createMandate(address,address,uint256,ui.notice: Create a payment mandate for `agent`. Does not move any tokens;         call `fund` afterwards (the owner must `approve` this vault first).

fund(uint256,uint256).notice: Deposit tokens into a mandate. Pulls from the mandate owner via         `transferFrom` (approve this contract first). Funding more than         the budget is allowed but pointless: payments are still capped         by `totalBudget`, and the excess comes back on revoke/close.

pay(uint256,address,uint256,string).notice: Execute a payment. Callable ONLY by the mandate's agent.         Enforces, in order: not revoked, not expired, per-tx cap,         total budget, deposited funds, payee allowlist.

revoke(uint256).notice: Instantly revoke a mandate and reclaim all unspent funds.         Works before or after expiry; the mandate can never pay again.

setPayeeAllowed(uint256,address,bool).notice: Add or remove a payee on the mandate allowlist (owner only).         Irrelevant when the mandate was created with `allowAnyPayee`.

spendable(uint256).notice: Spendable amount right now = min(remaining budget, deposited funds),         or 0 when revoked/expired. What an agent UI would poll before paying.
